_readme: Pokemon creators from Rochester, NY and the wider region. Drives /creators.html.
EMPTY UNTIL THE OWNER FILLS IT IN. These are real people. A wrong handle sends
traffic to a stranger, and a made-up creator is worse than an empty page.
AREA is one of: "Rochester, NY", "Buffalo", "Syracuse", or "Upstate NY" for anywhere else
close enough to count. Same rule as the card show calendar: check the zip or
the profile before adding. A national search for 'Rochester Pokemon' returns
Rochester MINNESOTA and Rochester MICHIGAN above ours.
Add one with a name and an area. Optional: blurb, youtube, instagram, tiktok,
twitch, url, does (what they make: rips, singles, art, competitive).
Handles go in WITHOUT the @ and without a full url. The builder links them.
THIS IS NOT A RANKING. Order is alphabetical by name, deliberately, so the
page cannot read as a league table of local creators.

THE ORDER OF THIS ARRAY IS THE ORDER ON THE PAGE and it is hand picked, not alphabetical. The owner, August 24, 2026: TOAK Pulls first. The page used to say the order was alphabetical and always would be, which was true and is not any more, so that sentence was rewritten in build-locals.mjs in the same change rather than left standing as a promise the file breaks. What the page still promises, and what is still true, is that no placement is paid for.

creators.name: TOAK Pulls
creators.does: Live streams, Pokemon comedy, pack openings
creators.logoNote: Sent by them for this use, August 27, 2026.
creators.blurb: They do all of it: live streams, comedy, and pack openings. Worth a follow, and you can buy from them in person at the local shows too.

creators.name: Elliot Does Pokemon
creators.does: Diamond and Pearl era, rare Pokemon facts, comedy, pack openings
creators.blurb: Elliot is a collector of the Diamond and Pearl era and mainly does content about "rare" Pokemon facts. He also occasionally does comedy, pack opening content, and sells cards.
creators.logoNote: Sent by the creator for this use, August 25, 2026.

creators.name: Jake's Place
creators.does: Inventory, pickups and where he is vending next
creators.doesNote: His own words on both accounts, read 8 September 2026: Instagram says "Avid collector and seller of video games, TCG, comics and more! Follow my page to keep up with inventory and where I'll [be]", and TikTok says "Avid collector and seller of video games, TCGs, and more!!". So `does` describes what the accounts actually carry rather than a format nobody has claimed: the owner called him a content creator, which he is, but neither bio mentions streams or a show and this file does not invent one.
creators.logoNote: Sent by them for this use, 8 September 2026.
creators.blurb: Jake is a lifelong collector of all things nerdy who has been vending for over a year: Pokemon, One Piece, Magic, Lorcana, video games, plush and more. Batavia, NY based, and he travels for it -- he has been as far as Pittsburgh and Ohio recently.
